title: Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships — Dues and Lifetime Price Schedule
content:
The Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships range comprises six memberships. In ascending order of the range they are Summit Club Essential, Summit Club Individual, Summit Club Individual Plus, Summit Club Executive, Summit Club Corporate and Summit Club Lifetime; a membership later in this order is a higher membership than one earlier in it.

## Schedule of dues and prices (USD)

| Membership | Annual dues | Lifetime purchase price | Lifetime membership | Membership year | Summit Gold and higher dues discount | Years that may be prepaid at once | Prepayment discount on each year's dues |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Club Essential | 349 | 0 (not applicable) | No | 12 calendar months | 50 | 1 | 0 percent |
| Summit Club Individual | 695 | 0 (not applicable) | No | 12 calendar months | 100 | 3 | 5 percent |
| Summit Club Individual Plus | 1095 | 0 (not applicable) | No | 12 calendar months | 100 | 3 | 5 percent |
| Summit Club Executive | 1495 | 0 (not applicable) | No | 12 calendar months | 150 | 3 | 10 percent |
| Summit Club Corporate | 1250 | 0 (not applicable) | No | 12 calendar months | 0 | 1 | 0 percent |
| Summit Club Lifetime | 0 (no dues) | 11500 | Yes | 12 calendar months | 0 | 0 | 0 percent |

## What each column states

- **Annual dues** — the dues for one membership year. A lifetime membership has annual dues of 0.
- **Lifetime purchase price** — the one-time price of a lifetime membership; 0 wherever the membership is not a lifetime membership.
- **Lifetime membership** — whether the membership never renews and never expires. Only Summit Club Lifetime is a lifetime membership.
- **Membership year** — the number of calendar months one membership year runs, counted from the membership's start date. It is 12 calendar months for every membership in the range.
- **Summit Gold and higher dues discount** — the amount in USD by which the dues are reduced for a member whose Summit tier is Summit Gold or higher.
- **Years that may be prepaid at once** — the number of membership years whose dues may be paid together in advance.
- **Prepayment discount** — the percentage by which each year's dues are reduced when that number of years is prepaid.

## Reading the schedule by membership

- Summit Club Individual, Summit Club Individual Plus and Summit Club Executive may each have 3 membership years prepaid at once. The discount on each year's dues is 5 percent for Summit Club Individual and Summit Club Individual Plus and 10 percent for Summit Club Executive.
- Summit Club Essential and Summit Club Corporate may have 1 membership year paid at a time, and the prepayment discount is 0 percent.
- Summit Club Corporate and Summit Club Lifetime carry no Summit Gold and higher dues discount (0 USD). Summit Club Essential carries 50 USD, Summit Club Individual and Summit Club Individual Plus 100 USD, and Summit Club Executive 150 USD.
- Summit Club Lifetime has no annual dues, no prepayment of years (0 years) and a single purchase price of 11500 USD.
